commands.command: set -euo pipefail; SEL='192.168.0.100:46769'; adb start-server >/dev/null; adb connect "$SEL" >/dev/null; M="$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')"; S="$(adb -s "$SEL" shell getprop ro.serialno | tr -d '\r')"; test "$M" = 'SM-S906B'; test "$S" = 'RFCT70L7E8J'; PKG='pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge'; adb -s "$SEL" shell pm grant "$PKG" android.permission.CALL_PHONE; adb -s "$SEL" shell pm grant "$PKG" android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE; adb -s "$SEL" shell pm grant "$PKG" android.permission.ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS; OUT="$(adb -s "$SEL" shell dumpsys package "$PKG")"; for P in android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO android.permission.CALL_PHONE android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE android.permission.ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS; do echo "$OUT" | grep -E "$P: granted=true" | head -1; done; echo 'runtime_permissions_ready=true'
